latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Add Music to Video App.

- Instantly add AI-generated music to video clips (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM up to 500MB).
- Automatic cloud connection and authentication; 100 free credits on signup.
- Simple prompt system: describe the edit you want (e.g., "add upbeat background music and fade out") and get a ready-to-download video in 20–40 seconds.
- Built-in export (1080p MP4 by default), batch processing, and timeline preview.
- API-driven workflow with clear error messages and tips for best results.
- Specially designed for TikTok and short-video creators without editing expertise.
